title: Mom Faces Arrest at School After Daughter’s Beatings Come to Light
description:
On September 11th, 2024. Deputies were called a school regarding injuries found on a child, according to statements, the child had a busted blood vessel near her eye and she had gotten hit multiple times in the face after she got the answers to her homework wrong.  The deputies conducted multiple interviews on her 3 kids and their statements all matched.   

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.

0:00 - Kid's Questioning
6:19 - Mom Arrives and Gets Arrested
